RANKING_KEY_MISMATCH: _wr_role_labels sorts perimeter WRs by the RAW tgt_share with a 0.0 default, while the quantity production actually scales is bayes_tgt_share. The two disagree. Montorie Foster is the clean case: his raw tgt_share is NaN -> 0.0, so he sorts last and gets no label, yet his bayes posterior (0.165842) is the second largest in the SEA receiving room -- larger than both the labelled WR1_5 and Cooper Kupp. So the role ranking and the allocated share are keyed on different quantities.
THE_ROUTING_ASYMMETRY: in simulation_rules.py the WR branches key on the COMPUTED role label while the TE and RB branches key on POSITION. So every TE and every RB receives an opponent-coverage target channel by position, but a WR receives one only if _wr_role_labels assigned him SLOT, WR1 or WR1_5 -- that is, slot plus the top two perimeter WRs by target share. Any other WR falls through the whole chain to tgt_mult = 1.0, and no diagnostic records it.

direct_wr_coverage_target_rule_layer_del.SCOPE: this is ONLY the direct WR coverage-target rule-layer delta. It is NOT total opponent attribution and does NOT make any WR globally opponent-insensitive (audit 6445134492 blocker 3). Shared pass_eff_mult can still move YPT, and the M38/entitlement stages move a WR's share for teammate-structural reasons, which is indirect opponent exposure.
direct_wr_coverage_target_rule_layer_del.WHY_THIS_MATTERS_MORE_THAN_V1_SAID: the zone gate DID fire for KC. No WR role has a zone route at all -- wr1 and wr1_5 key only on coverage_man_rate -- so zone coverage, the most common NFL coverage family, moved every TE (x1.265) and every RB/FB (x1.200) and could not move any WR. V1 reported the WR zero without noting that the defense was in a configuration which paid out to every position-routed player.
direct_wr_coverage_target_rule_layer_del.distinction: Kupp's zero is STRUCTURAL -- as an unlabelled WR he is ineligible whatever the defense does. JSN's zero is CIRCUMSTANTIAL -- he was eligible and the man gate did not fire.

gate_decode.corroboration: coverage_zone_rate is decoded independently by the TE and RB groups and coverage_man_rate independently by WR1 and WR1_5; agreement is corroboration, not a single-group inference

derived_consequences.pass_eff_note: pressure is not > 0.075, so pass_eff_mult is not 0.98. It is 1.00, or 1.01 if pressure < -0.075, which the preserved artifact cannot separate because rules_pass_eff_mult -- which apply_rules_to_metrics DOES emit -- was not preserved. Field 8 is therefore BOUNDED, not resolved.

gate_firing.decode_basis: the rules layer applies no normalization, so the rules/bayes ratio IS the multiplier. Each role's achievable products are distinct, so an exact match identifies the gate state uniquely.
gate_firing.decode_residual_condition: holds for rows with no injury redistribution and no injury limitation, either of which would break the exact match
gate_firing.man_gate_argument: WR1 takes x0.95 and WR1_5 x1.15, so a fired gate would split their rules/bayes ratios. observed WR ratios: [1.0]. identical => not fired.
